Quick Reference
ALTCS Medicaid
AZ resident 65+ or disabled. Income limit ~$2,829/mo. Asset limit ~$2,000. Covers AL, Memory Care, SNF. Not all facilities accept it.
VA Aid and Attendance
90+ days active duty with 1 wartime day. Single veteran up to $2,295/mo. Married up to $2,727/mo. Can combine with ALTCS in some cases.
Long-Term Care Insurance
Review policy for elimination period, daily benefit amount, and inflation protection. Most AL qualifies. Confirm with carrier before placement.

Export for Your Bookkeeper
Cash-basis CSV files: payments and refunds are counted in the year they happened. Opens in Excel, Google Sheets, or QuickBooks.
Totals by facility flag which facilities reached the 1099-NEC reporting threshold ($2,000 for 2026 payments, $600 for 2025 and earlier), so you can match them against the 1099s you receive. Income is taxable either way. Confirm with your accountant.

Backup & Restore
Every client, facility, invoice, and signed document lives only on this device. Export a copy regularly — especially before switching phones.
Restoring will replace all current data on this device with what's in the backup file. Export a fresh backup first if you want to keep what's currently here.
